How ordering works

No pressure and no hard sell — just a few messages back and forth, and we handle the making.

1

Tell us the basics

Pick a package below, tell us how many you need and when you need them, and send your logo or idea. Use the form, email, or WhatsApp — whatever is easiest.

2

We design & quote it

We’ll put together your design with your logo and colors and send a clear, custom quote based on your quantity. Nothing is made until you’re happy with it.

3

We make it, you give it

Each piece is made to order and finished ready to hand out — at the office, the event, or under the tree.

Make it yours

Add a personal touch to any package, or order single items on their own.

✦ QR Gift Experience

Our signature extra: a QR code on the gift that opens your photos, a video, or a voice note. It turns a mug or tumbler into a moment — perfect for appreciation gifts, thank-yous, and keepsakes.

Add it to any package — just ask

Gift Planning

Not sure what to give your team or clients? Tell us the occasion and your budget, and we’ll plan the gifts for you — ideas, items, and timing, all handled.
